title: auth.security.audit (schema_version 1)
description: Published by the audit module via the outbox whenever a security-relevant action occurs (login success/failure, lock, unlock, MFA events, password/key changes, token reuse, API-key operations — R43). A reduced mirror of the stored auth_audit row: IP and the hashed user agent stay in the database only, downstream consumers get the security-relevant facts, not the forensic detail.

eventType.description: The audited action's own identifier (e.g. login.failed, api_key.revoked).

accountUuid.description: The account the event is about. Nullable: not every audited action is scoped to a specific account (see AuditService.partitionKey's own fallback for events with no account).

actorUuid.description: Who performed the action, which may differ from accountUuid for admin operations. Nullable: not every audited action has a distinct actor (e.g. an automated/system-initiated event).
